notes: Each meal in the E-mess picker now has a That's-it toggle that collapses that meal's menu once you're done with it (tap again to reopen), so you are not scrolling every meal at once. The reps/weight page now has - / + steppers and shows each exercise's calories burned live (as a negative), updating as you change reps or weight - computed from the same work-against-gravity model the app logs. The live macro readout now spells out Protein, Carbs, Fat and Fibre, one per row. Each E-mess meal item now shows a live macro readout (kcal, protein, carbs, fat, fibre) that updates as you tap - / + or type the amount. The per-meal "already logged" record now persists across reloads (saved per day and per profile, cleared on a day-clear), so no food ever shows a cross-meal false positive. Fixed: a food shared across meals (milk in breakfast and snacks) no longer shows as already logged in the other meal - the picker and reminders now track what you entered per meal, not by the day total. In the IISc Veg Mess popup, tapping a mess now highlights it with a teal outline and a Save button confirms the choice. IISc Veg Mess: the You tab now asks "Do you eat at the IISc Veg Mess?" with an A/D/E mess selector, and a one-time popup asks on update. Menus and reminders are active for E mess (A/D coming). Fixed the Fulka item logging as Chapati. Dishes you've already logged for a meal are now tucked into a collapsed "Already logged" group in the E-mess picker (and dropped from meal reminders), so you only see what's still pending. E-mess amount boxes now have - / + steppers (0.5 for fulka/katori/piece, 50 ml for liquids, 10 g for dry weights); you can still type any value. E-mess meal windows set to the real times (breakfast 7:30-10:00, lunch 12:30-14:00, snacks 16:30-18:00, dinner 19:30-21:00): reminders now nudge from each window's start and the meal picker offers a meal once its window has begun. E-mess meal entry is now one page: tick a dish and an amount box opens under it (fulka/katori in 0.5 steps, liquids in 50 ml, or type your own), with one time per meal at its heading. Fixed: mess-meal amounts now count toward the day's calories and show in What you ate. E-mess (IISc): Add-what-you-ate now has a Today's E-mess meal button that lists every meal whose time has already passed, lets you tick dishes across them, then set amount and time for each on one page. Plus the earlier Exercised enlarge/flip body map and the day's E-mess menu in meal reminders. Exercised flow: a search bar plus the front/back body map, with a new Enlarge view that shows one side at a time and a Flip button for precise muscle picking; the muscles you pick are named as you go. New E-mess (IISc) menu: a profile toggle that surfaces the day's E-mess breakfast/lunch/snacks/dinner in your meal reminders (each meal on its own, with an Exercised prompt), driven by the weekly rota; the whole menu stays searchable. Footer now links to the author's site and a contact email.
